item.description: Today, the Reserve Bank released the second edition of its biennial Report titled “Finances of Panchayati Raj Institutions”. The theme of this edition is ‘Local Finances and Capacity Building in Rural India’. Drawing upon a balanced panel of 2.25 lakh Gram Panchayats for the period 2022-23 to 2024-25, the Report presents an assessment of their finances and their role in achieving sustainable and inclusive rural socio-economic development.
